packaged_from_head.subject: What wmv22's first live outing taught the mining cycle

contents: Per-run agent workspaces. The six 08-23/08-24 runs carry text artefacts only (raw PNG frames and scratch tmp/ removed). The seven closed-loop runs added 2026-08-28 additionally include the curated frames under memory/episodes/*/frames/ — the frames the run's own logs.txt [FRAME] pointers address, and the ones the agent zooms when adjudicating a detector flag. Those runs wrote no separate frames/ directory, so nothing was stripped from them. One .tar.gz per run under runs/, each extracting to <name>/episode_001/.

caveats: The dragon pair (dragon_pl, dragon_wm) launched at 04:02/04:04 on 2026-08-24; commit 8481a3a ('Keep paired arms from overwriting each other's results') landed at 04:12:56, ten minutes into the run. The already-launched processes were not affected, but the code on disk changed mid-run.
Code HEAD per run is reconstructed from git reflog timestamps against each run's earliest artefact mtime. It was not stamped by the launcher at run time.
Working trees may have carried uncommitted changes at launch; only the committed HEAD is recorded here.
Raw PNG frames (640x360, ~350KB each, 6.2G across these runs) and scratch tmp/ were stripped. They remain on the origin host under output/<run>/episode_001/frames/.
Scoring is a milestone COUNT, not a sequence; several world-model runs bank out of order.
Every baseline cell is n=1. On diamond the matched-knowledge prolong control (20.0) scores below the no-knowledge prolong (40.0); read that inversion as variance until more seeds land.
No run of any arm on either task has reached mine_iron_ore. Diamond caps at 6/10, dragon at 6/24, and the six milestones are identical on both.
